Panigaon Omprakash Dinodia College
The most prestigious institution of higher education in Panigaon, covering a considerable territory of Telahi and Kamalabaria Mouza in the District of Lakhimpur, was founded in the year 1984. The College is affiliated to Dibrugarh University, became part of the Deficit System of Grant Aid in 1996 and provincialized in 2005 in accordance with the Assam College Provincialization Act of 2005. It has already celebrated its Silver Jubilee in 2009, marking 38 years of illustrious service to the community by providing higher education opportunities. The National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) has assessed the College and renewed its accreditation.

From Principal's Desk
Institutes of higher education play a vital role in a nation's development, fostering the growth of highly skilled individuals who shape the future. These institutions nurture talent, producing academics, planners, policymakers, scientists, and technologists who drive progress and lead the nation forward.
In line with this vision, Panigaon OPD College was established in 1984 under the affiliation of Dibrugarh University, Assam. Dedicated to providing accessible and affordable higher education to students from economically disadvantaged and marginalized backgrounds, the college has emerged as a beacon of hope.
Additionally, the college promotes computer literacy, conducts skill development programs for self-employment, and provides career counseling. It also offers distance education via Dibrugarh University, KKHSOU, and Assam State Open School.
Panigaon OPD College is committed to excellence and to preparing students to meet the challenges of a rapidly changing world.
